svg.title: Indian SECC local velocity-normal diagnostics
svg.desc: Twelve 2013 monthly maps of local Indian SECC candidate paths, source eastward velocities, original seeds and paired velocity-normal diagnostic spans. All five station checks pass in only one 10 km case and no seed passes at both 5 km and 10 km. Failed or partial candidates remain dashed; there is no admitted named-current axis or width.
